sloka: पदातिबलसम्पन्नान् प्रेषयामास रावणः ।परिघेणैव तान् सर्वान्नयामि यमसादनम् ।। ५.५८.१२० ।।११७ ।।।।
transliteration: padātibalasampannān preṣayāmāsa rāvaṇaḥ ।parigheṇaiva tān sarvānnayāmi yamasādanam ।। 5.58.120 ।।117 ।।।।

translations.english: "I sent all of them to the abode of Yama with just an iron bar. Having heard about the death of the less powerful ones, Ravana sent five heroic army generals.
